pages.text: Smoke any log in a smoker into a $(item)Seasoned Billet$().
pages.title: Seasoning

pages.text: Pour a finish into an empty cauldron to make a $(item)Finishing Vat$().$(li)$(item)Linseed Oil$(): four wheat seeds, in a cooking pot. ★3$(li)$(item)Heartwood Resin$(): from the dryads. ★5$(li)$(item)Sylvan Sap$(): from the dryads. ★7$(br2)Billets come out as $(item)Cured Billets$() of the finish's ★.
pages.title: Curing

pages.text: Each vat takes four pieces a batch and uses a level of liquid. Better liquids take longer: 2 minutes at ★3, 3 at ★5, 4 at ★7. Right-click with an empty hand to take the batch out, or to see how long it has left.
pages.title: The Vat
